title: I Understand How You Feel: Enhancing Deeper Emotional Support Through Multilingual Emotional Validation in Dialogue System

live_model.evidence: Sec. 3.2: 'instruction-tuned large language models: Llama-3.1 8B-Instruct and GPT-4.1 nano, each in zero-shot, 3-shot prompt-engineering, CoT and LoRA regimes'.

prompt.location: Appendix K.4 (validation timing detection: definition + instruction printed; the three-shot example dialogues are described, not printed)
prompt.note: The zero-shot variant is effectively fully printed; formatting of the dialogue context fed to the model is not specified.

claim.metric: macro-F1 (%), validation timing detection, multilingual M-EDESConv test, zero-shot
claim.location: Table 2, Multilingual block, row 'GPT 4.1 Nano - Zero-shot', M-EDESConv Overall M-F1

data.source: M-EDESConv and M-TESC released on GitHub (zihaurpang); M-EDESConv test = 4,636 validating + 8,144 non-validating utterances

notes: Datasets are GPT-4.1-mini-translated extensions of EmpatheticDialogues/ESConv with 94% automatic labels; the human-validated subset (500 per language block) is a smaller alternative target.

resolution.plan: Appendix K.4 prints the zero-shot prompt (validation definition plus the validate/non-validate instruction); the three-shot examples are not printed but the Table 2 zero-shot row does not need them. Feed each M-EDESConv test utterance with its preceding dialogue context (Sec. 3: classification given the context up to the utterance) to gpt-4.1-nano, map the output to validate/non-validate, and compute macro-F1 over the 12,780 test utterances (4,636 validating, 8,144 non-validating) from the project GitHub release.
resolution.approximation: Context formatting (speaker tags, number of prior turns) unspecified; the trailing 'Let's think step by step' line may belong only to the CoT regime; temperature unstated.
